After the Freedom250 event at the White House portrayed a celebratory President Trump on a victory lap, a different beast may reveal itself on particular issues such as the Middle East, explains former CNN Europe editor Nina Dos Santos.

Nina Dos Santos was speaking to Kate McCann and Stig Abell on Times Radio. Listen live everyday 6-10am.

description:
“The fact that he is discussing that with Mark Carney is a signal, perhaps, that he himself is looking into it.”

Keir Starmer and Mark Carney had a drink last night where they are understood to have spoken about financing defence, as John Healey’s resignation recommended following a Canadian model for defence funding, says Anna Mikhailova who reports from the G7. 

Anna Mikhailova was speaking to Kate McCann and Stig Abell on Times Radio Breakfast. Listen live everyday from 6-10am.
